name: 18 Kin Sound Novel Game Natsuko
original_name: 18禁サウンドノベルゲーム奈津子
source:
Shou-kun was a 20-year-old freelancer in love for the first time.
The girl of his affections also seemed to like him. But due to his lifestyle
they couldn't be together, she said. Shou-kun loved her... but not
enough to give up his single life, get married, and have a kid...

Shaken by the lost chance, Shou-kun began to work hard and save money.
Years passed, and one day he met the girl of his affections again...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ074716.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Shou-kun是一名20岁的自由职业者，这是他第一次坠入爱河。
他喜欢的女孩似乎也喜欢他，但她说，因为他的生活方式，两人无法在一起。
Shou-kun爱她……却还没有爱到愿意放弃单身生活、结婚生子的地步。

错失良机让Shou-kun深受打击，于是他开始努力工作、存钱。
几年过去，有一天，他再次遇见了自己喜欢的女孩……
